identity.title: The Museum of Almosts
identity.concept: A midnight museum that keeps the relationships that almost happened, each one folded and sealed under glass.
identity.premise: Two paper figures, HER and HIM, are exhibits in neighbouring cases. A ruby thread runs between their worlds and keeps coming close to joining them. On the line where she asks him to hold it tight, it breaks.
identity.emotional_intention: Tender, held-breath longing that turns into quiet acceptance: the audience should ache for the touch and understand, at the end, why it never comes.
identity.audience_experience: The viewer walks the museum like a late visitor: close to the glass, unable to step in, reading the distance between two figures more than their faces.
identity.central_metaphor: Origami: a feeling folded so carefully it can be kept, but never unfolded without tearing.
identity.song_relationship: The song is about almost: almost staying, almost saying it. Paper suits that: it holds a shape only while nobody presses on it, and every fold is a decision that can be seen but not undone. The figures never sing; the lyric is the voice of the museum around them, and the thread carries what the words leave unsaid.

world.description: One gallery of a museum after closing time: midnight blue-black walls, antique brass display cases with smoked glass, a dark reflective floor, small amber practical lamps above each case. Every exhibit is folded paper.
physical_rules: Everything alive is folded paper; paper bends only at its creases and never stretches
Glass separates every exhibit; nothing passes through glass except the ruby thread
The only moving light is the amber practicals; there is no daylight and no window
The museum is always empty of visitors; the camera is the only witness
world.architecture: Long symmetrical galleries with arched doorways; cases at waist height on brass legs; a central aisle that the camera travels like a visitor.
world.environment: Still air, a little paper dust caught in the lamp light, faint reflections of the cases on the floor.
world.scale: The figures are about the height of a hand inside life-size cases, so the room feels vast around them.
world.time_and_light: Always after midnight; the practicals are the only light.
belongs: brass labels with no readable text
small paper keepsakes: a letter, a key, a boat
world.prompt_line: a midnight museum gallery of antique brass display cases with smoked glass on a dark reflective floor

characters.name: HER
characters.silhouette: Slender, upright, a long folded skirt that widens to a crisp triangle; head tilted slightly toward the thread.
characters.construction: Folded from a single sheet with no cuts; the face is a smooth plane with no drawn features.
characters.materials: Deep garnet washi paper, slightly translucent at the edges.
characters.costume: The skirt is the sheet itself; one sharp fold across the shoulders like a shawl.
characters.color: Deep garnet, darker than the thread so the thread reads as the warmest thing in the frame.
details: visible paper fibres at the hem
one loose fold at the wrist where the thread is tied
constraints: never a second colour on her
characters.prompt_line: HER, a slender folded origami woman of deep garnet washi paper with a crisp triangular skirt and no drawn face

allowed: a slow turn at the waist fold
lifting one arm from the shoulder crease

characters.name: HIM
characters.silhouette: Broader, square-shouldered, upright like a folded coat; always slightly turned away.
characters.construction: Folded from heavier card with sharp square creases; the face is a smooth plane with no drawn features.
characters.materials: Charcoal grey heavyweight paper with a matte surface.
characters.costume: A folded collar that stands up at the back of the neck.
characters.color: Charcoal grey, cool against her ruby.
details: a single crease line down the centre of his back
the thread tied at his wrist
characters.prompt_line: HIM, a square-shouldered folded origami man of charcoal grey heavyweight paper with a standing collar and no drawn face

materials.name: washi paper
materials.properties: Thin, fibrous, a little translucent; creases stay sharp.
materials.light_response: Amber light glows through the edges and shows the fibres.
materials.motion_response: Bends only at folds; edges tremble slightly; never stretches or melts.

materials.name: smoked glass
materials.properties: Dark, slightly reflective, separates every exhibit.
materials.light_response: Holds soft reflections of the practicals.

objects.name: display case
objects.meaning: What keeps them apart and also what keeps them safe.
objects.appearance: Antique brass frame, smoked glass, a small blank brass label.

objects.name: paper boat
objects.appearance: A small ruby paper boat in an empty case.

color.relationships: Ruby is the only saturated colour; it belongs to HER and the thread. Charcoal is HIM. Everything else is midnight and brass.
color.contrast: Deep blacks with small warm pools of light; the figures never brighter than the thread.
color.prompt_line: midnight blue-black and antique brass with warm amber light and one ruby accent

sources: small amber practical lamps above each case
lighting.quality: Soft, low, pooled; the room falls into darkness between cases.
lighting.shadows: Long soft shadows of the figures inside the cases; never hard noon shadows.
lighting.atmosphere: A little paper dust drifting in the lamp light gives depth.
lighting.prompt_line: warm amber practical lamps in pools of soft light

camera.framing: Symmetrical, case-centred frames; the two figures usually on opposite thirds with the thread between them.
camera.distance: Wide for the room, macro for the figures; never a casual medium shot.
camera.lens: Long lens for the figures to compress the gap between cases.
camera.depth_of_field: Shallow on the figures, the room falling into soft focus.
movement: slow dolly along the aisle like a visitor
gentle push in toward the glass
locked off macro on the thread
camera.negative_space: The empty space between the cases carries the story; keep it in frame.
camera.rhythm: Slow, one move per shot, cuts on the line changes.
camera.transitions: Cut, never dissolve; the museum is precise.

motifs.name: ruby thread
motifs.meaning: The connection between them: what is felt and never said.
motifs.first_appearance: Running across the floor in the opening wide, before either figure is seen.

evolution.meaning: a connection nobody has noticed yet

evolution.state: taut, leading out of frame toward HIM
the two ends almost touching between the cases
snapped, the two ends falling apart
evolution.meaning: it was never going to be held

motifs.payoff: On the line 'hold the thread and hold it tight' the thread snaps: the request and the break are the same moment.

materials: paper bends only at its creases

required: the ruby thread in every shot with a figure
glass between the figures until the last shot
constraints.negative: photorealistic people, skin, text, logos, watermark
never_change: HER is deep ruby paper and HIM charcoal grey paper
the figures have no drawn faces
may_evolve: the tension and state of the ruby thread
how close the camera comes to the glass
